label: Conditional fission identity and symmetric selection boundary
paraphrase: In one occurrence-role framework, two continuation edges and identity sufficiency exclude distinct later bearers. A deterministic equivariant selector cannot pick one of two distinct swapped outputs from fixed data. Solo identity verdicts plus their explicit cross-context invariance exclude distinct split bearers, without cross-context individual equality. Nonempty finite controls omit identity sufficiency, edges, distinctness, selector equivariance, admissibility, data fixedness, swapping or output distinctness. Positive nonbranching and overlapping-trajectory controls are included. These are structural surrogates; actual persons, psychologically adequate continuity, metaphysical fission, complete selector-data symmetry and any Creed interpretation remain open. Analyst formulation, attribution deferred; no root premise changes.
